description.text: The fifth Sun & Moon set, released on 2 February 2018 with 173 cards: 156 and 17 secret rares. It brought in Prism Star cards, six of them here: a deck may hold only one of each, and they go to the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. It brings Pokémon from Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, among them Dawn Wings Necrozma and Dusk Mane Necrozma, and nine of its ultra rares are full-art Supporters. Its gold full-art Lunala-GX and Solgaleo-GX come from the Japanese GX Battle Boost; only two English sets, Legendary Treasures and Phantom Forces, had had gold full-art cards before.
